info.name: MyVision API
info.description:
MyVision SaaS invoicing & project billing backend (Spring Boot, http://localhost:8080).

Import the matching environment 'MyVision Local' and select it. Run 'Auth > Register' first (or use the Collection Runner top-to-bottom) — it captures the access token and ids into the environment so every other request is authenticated automatically.

Collection-level auth is Bearer {{token}}; public auth endpoints override this to no-auth.

request.description: Public liveness probe.
Spring Boot actuator health endpoint (public).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, tokens and current user. POST /api/auth/** is public.

request.description: Creates a user + company and returns access + refresh tokens. Pre-request generates a unique email so this can be re-run.
Logs in with the credentials created by Register and refreshes the stored tokens.
Returns the authenticated user + company. Requires Bearer token.
Exchanges the refresh token for a new access token.
Always returns 200 (does not reveal whether the email exists). With MAIL_PROVIDER=log the reset link is printed to the API container logs.
Sets a new password using the token from the forgot-password email. Set {{resetToken}} first; expected to 400 with a placeholder token.
Verifies the account email using the token from the verification email. Set {{verifyToken}} first; expected to 400 with a placeholder token.
Exchanges a Google ID token for app tokens. Needs a real Google idToken; expected to 400/401 with a placeholder.
Exchanges an Apple identity token for app tokens. Needs a real Apple identityToken; expected to 400/401 with a placeholder.
Revokes the given refresh token. NOTE: running this invalidates {{refreshToken}} for later requests — run it last or re-login afterwards.

item.name: Clients
item.description: Company clients (customers). The DELETE (archive) lives in the Cleanup folder so the client stays available for projects/quotes/invoices during a full run.

request.description: Lists active clients for the current company.
Fetches a single client by id.
Partial update — only non-null fields are applied.

item.name: Projects
item.description: Construction/service projects linked to a client.

request.description: Creates a project for {{clientId}} and stores {{projectId}}.
Partial update — only non-null fields are applied.

request.description: Partial update of a draft quote. Supplying items replaces all existing items.
Transitions the quote draft -> sent.
Marks a sent quote as accepted.
Marks a sent quote as rejected. In a full run the quote was just accepted, so this returns 400 (invalid transition) — that is the expected conflict response.
Creates an invoice from an accepted quote and stores {{invoiceId}}. Returns 400 if the quote is not in an acceptable state.

request.description: Partial update of a draft invoice. Supplying items replaces all existing items.
Transitions the invoice draft -> sent/unpaid. Runs before payments so a payment can be recorded.
Renders the invoice as a PDF (binary).
Renders and stores the invoice PDF, returning a document record.
Exports the invoice as XRechnung XML (German e-invoice).
Generates and stores the XRechnung XML, returning a document record.
ZUGFeRD hybrid PDF export. Intentionally returns 501 Not Implemented in this build — it requires PDF/A-3 embedding and validator certification before production use.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payments recorded against an invoice; updates balance and status. Runs after the invoice is marked sent and before it is marked paid.

request.description: Lists payments for {{invoiceId}}.
Records a payment against {{invoiceId}} and stores {{paymentId}}. Returns 400 if the invoice is already paid/cancelled.

item.name: Invoice status
item.description: Terminal invoice status transitions. These run after Payments so the earlier payment succeeds against an unpaid invoice.

request.description: Marks the invoice fully paid.
Cancels the invoice. In a full run the invoice was just marked paid, so this returns 400 (invalid transition) — the expected conflict response.
Uploads a company logo (PNG/JPEG/WEBP/SVG, < 2MB). Select a file for the 'file' form field in Postman before sending.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Aggregated metrics for the current company.

request.description: Returns aggregated counts and totals for the current company.

item.name: Cleanup
item.description: Destructive deletes, intentionally last. Deleting the project then archiving the client frees up the resources created earlier in the run.

request.description: Deletes the project created earlier in the run.
Soft-deletes (archives) the client created earlier in the run.
